sections.text: The starting point is always hard, the middle will be rough, but only those who make it to the end will enjoy the sweetness of the pain.

sections.heading: Word from God
sections.body: Biblical teachings, Scripture reflections, and studies that explore what the Bible says and how it applies to everyday life.

sections.heading: A short note from the writer
sections.body:
**Behind the word**

Every piece of writing begins somewhere: a question, a passage of Scripture, a moment in life, or an idea that refuses to remain unwritten.

**EverRock Write** brings these thoughts together through biblical reflections, poetry, personal writing, and fiction.

This is a space for exploring ideas, expressing experiences, and telling stories with purpose.
sections.alt: Image of the writer, the founder and CEO of EverRock Write

hero_text:
Some words help us understand faith. Others give shape to feelings we struggle to express. Some take us into stories that exist only in imagination.

EverRock Write is a home for biblical reflections, poetry, life experiences, and original fiction. A place to explore Scripture, reflect on life, and share stories worth reading
